SourceProxy.label: SHYX Point Cloud Surface SDF
SourceProxy.name: SHYXPointCloudSurfaceSDF

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Point Cloud Surface SDF: Signed distance from point cloud to a surface (VTK ImplicitPolyDataDistance).

SourceProxy.Documentation: For each point in the first input (point cloud vtkDataSet), evaluates signed distance to the second input using vtkImplicitPolyDataDistance (internal clean + triangulation, vtkCellLocator, angle-weighted pseudonormals). Non-polydata reference surfaces are extracted with vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter. Open surfaces are allowed. The scalar array is named SDF.

InputProperty.name: PointCloud
InputProperty.label: Point Cloud
InputProperty.Documentation: Point cloud (vtkPolyData or any vtkDataSet; all points are sampled; one vtkVertex per point when none exist).

InputProperty.name: ReferenceSurface
InputProperty.label: Reference Surface
InputProperty.Documentation: Reference surface (vtkPolyData or vtkDataSet; volume inputs are surfaced with vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter).

IntVectorProperty.name: TakeAbsoluteValue
IntVectorProperty.label: Take Absolute Value
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON (default), store the absolute value of the signed distance in the SDF array. If OFF, keep the signed distance (negative inside / positive outside).
